HeadlineAurocAdaptive.meaning: mean AUROC of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule, over the 65 cells it covers of the 65-cell panel

HeadlineAurocMatched.meaning: mean AUROC of the recommended placement at the matched 0.6 rule, over the 65 cells it covers of the 65-cell panel

PublishedAurocAdaptive.meaning: mean AUROC of the published placement at the adaptive rule, over the 65 cells it covers of the 65-cell panel

HeadlineGainAdaptiveAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC gain of the recommended placement over the published placement, both at the adaptive rule, paired over the 65-cell panel

HeadlineGainAdaptiveAurocLow.meaning: lower bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on headline_gain_adaptive_auroc

HeadlineGainAdaptiveAurocHigh.meaning: upper bound of the 95% bootstrap interval on headline_gain_adaptive_auroc

HeadlineGainMatchedAuroc.meaning: mean AUROC gain of the recommended placement at the matched 0.6 rule over the published placement at the adaptive rule, paired over the 65-cell panel

HeadlineTprAtOnePercent.meaning: mean TPR of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule, at the 1% FPR budget, over the 65 cells it covers

HeadlineFloorAuroc.meaning: minimum single-cell AUROC of the recommended placement at the adaptive rule, over the 65-cell panel

HeadlineInversions.meaning: cells where the recommended placement at the adaptive rule scores AUROC below 0.5, out of the 65-cell panel

PrimaryGainAdaptiveAuroc.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain of recommended over published, both at the adaptive rule, on the primary datasets cifar100 and tiny

HardGainAdaptiveAuroc.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain of recommended over published, both at the adaptive rule, on the hard attacks

CifarOneZeroZeroOnePercentGain.meaning: mean paired AUROC gain of recommended over published, both at the adaptive rule, on cifar100 at 1% poisoning only, n=5
